title: Generated IMAGEDEF hard-owner readback profile
scope: Accept the ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.81 IMAGEDEF parent hard-owner encoding emitted by libdxfrw's DWG writer, in both the shared OBJECTS prologue preflight and typed IMAGEDEF parser. Keep generic OBJECTS parent-role validation unchanged and do not promote the physical AutoCAD code-0xC source profile or strict image output.

implementation.behavior: An explicit IMAGEDEF-only policy flag reaches the common handle-tail parser. It admits parent role DwgHardOwnership (raw code 3) alongside the existing offset soft-pointer decoding; other object types retain the prior soft-pointer rule. The central pre-dispatch common-prologue check passes the policy only for resolved IMAGEDEF type, and DRW_ImageDef::parseDwg passes it at its typed tail check.
implementation.testInputPolicy: Tests generate temporary DWGs locally from scratch and remove them after each run. No DWG/DXF fixture is added to the repository.

generatedWriterRoleBytes.result: PASS, 1/1. Generated literal handle streams cover eight DWG revisions, non-null and canonical-null references, IMAGEDEF hard-owner parent code 3, and reactor soft-pointer code 4.

generatedNativeReadback.result: PASS, 1/1. Locally generated AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 DWGs import with typed IMAGE, IMAGEDEF and IMAGEDEF_REACTOR identities; the IMAGEDEF dictionary owner, reactor target and reactor owner relationships match.

existingWriterTransaction.result: PASS, 1/1. Existing IMAGEDEF plan failure, rollback, retry and readback controls remain green.

broaderSelectors.result: Both still fail after reaching later whole-source/output checks for a generated AC1027 profile. The source diagnostic reports an AcDb:Header integrity mismatch (expected 496, observed 500), followed by strict source-reference/output refusal. These failures do not occur in the dedicated generated IMAGEDEF import selector and are not relaxed by this change.

preservedScratchSource.provenance: A temporary copy of a locally authored generated test input; not committed.
preservedScratchSource.result: PASS; conversion completed with the corrected reader. This source has no preserved source-pair or producer qualification.

limits: The physical AutoCAD AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 cohort's offset soft-pointer parent code 0xC remains an unqualified source profile; the independent receipt docs/research/p6-imagedef-cross-version-soft-role-evidence-2026-11-07.json remains authoritative for that observation.
Strict DXF output, source graph closure, deletion/ownership semantics, native consumers, and producer breadth are unchanged and remain gated.
The AC1027 HEADER integrity mismatch and broader source-output refusal remain unresolved.
nextAction: Continue with an independently supported local parser/no-loss gap. Resolve the AC1027 HEADER envelope mismatch as its own source-backed item; revisit nonempty physical IMAGEDEF output only when eligible owner-semantics evidence resolves the code-3 versus code-0xC profile conflict.
